reply: [{"query":"根据ICH E6(R3)指南,受试者参与临床试验应获得的具体报酬金额或支付标准是什么?","query_en":"According to the ICH E6(R3) guideline, what is the specific amount or payment schedule for compensating trial participants?","topic":"受试者报酬具体金额标准","absence_terms":["specific amount","payment schedule","compensation rate","monetary sum"],"nearest_clause":{"page":16,"text":"If the trial participants are compensated for their participation in the trial, the IRB/IEC should review both the amount and method of payment to participants to assure that neither presents problems of coercion or undue influence on the trial participants."},"rationale":"该问题询问受试者报酬的具体金额,而文档仅要求IRB/IEC审查报酬金额与支付方式是否存在胁迫风险(1.2.8),未给出任何具体数额或计算标准,此类具体金额本就超出该原则性指南的规定范畴。"},{"query":"根据ICH E6(R3)指南,对于严重违反GCP的申办者或研究者,具体的处罚或制裁措施(如罚款)是什么?","query_en":"According to the ICH E6(R3) guideline, what specific penalties or sanctions (e.g., fines) apply to sponsors or investigators for serious GCP noncompliance?","topic":"GCP违规的具体处罚措施","absence_terms":["penalty","fine","sanction","处罚"],"nearest_clause":{"page":69,"text":"Description of the process for the handling of noncompliance with the protocol or GCP."},"rationale":"该问题询问违反GCP应受到的具体处罚或制裁,而文档仅要求描述处理不合规情形的流程(B.12.3)及建立预防复发的策略(6.3),从未规定具体的罚款或制裁措施,此类执法处罚属于监管机构职权而非本指南所涵盖的内容。"}]
